title: Paloma and the Orbit
author: Juniper Voss
blurb: Paloma Delacroix, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
